visualCharacteristics.purpose: Featured article intro: image beside breadcrumbs, heading and byline

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: (1) image; (2) breadcrumb links in one paragraph, H2 title, byline paragraphs (author, date / read time)
contentPattern.description: Image beside breadcrumbs, heading and byline meta — Fixed two-column layout of an image beside different content (breadcrumbs, heading, byline)
contentPattern.notes: rc1: col1 H1+subheading+2 links, col2 3 images; rc2: col1 image, col2 breadcrumb links, H2, byline paragraphs

usage: Featured case study / article lead with breadcrumb trail and author meta.
reuseGuidance: Use when an image sits beside article meta. Link-only paragraphs before the heading become breadcrumbs; paragraphs after it become the byline.
